baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَذَٰلِكَ مَا أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا
baseline_models.mechanism: Likeness, temporal predecessors, messenger-arrival, and communal speech form a recurrent call-and-response: a bearer reaches a people and they answer by classification.

activation_trace.role: Coming and reaching supply the incoming event around which the response forms.
Temporal precedence extends the encounter backward through earlier communities.
A bearer together with a carried message defines what enters the encounter.
Articulated speech supplies the recurrent communal reply.

changed_reading.before: Earlier peoples happened to insult their messengers in similar terms.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a recurrent arrival-and-reply mechanism in which messenger-bearing speech repeatedly elicits the same verbal classification.

baseline_models.mechanism: The disjunction covers opposed causal accounts: deliberate speech that diverts perception or speech from a mind whose reason is covered. Either alternative prevents the utterance from being received as a message.

activation_trace.role: The bearer-message relation supplies the epistemic status that the labels displace.
Speech as professed belief makes the reply a settled account of the messenger, not a passing noise.
Diversion, deception, and perceptual redirection assign the speaker excessive manipulative agency.
Reason covered by madness assigns the speaker deficient agency.

changed_reading.before: Magician and madman are two roughly synonymous insults.
changed_reading.after: The pair is an epistemic quarantine: the messenger is either a calculating manipulator or an incapacitated speaker, so his message is excluded under both alternatives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Moses episode supplies a worked instance of the focus pattern: compelling, meaning-disclosing authority is followed by a ruler turning away through an established support and then reproducing the exact binary. The labels therefore operate as a recoding device that lets supported refusal survive disclosed evidence.

activation_trace.role: Perceptual diversion supplies one half of the focus ayah's recoding device.
Covered reason supplies the alternative recoding of the same speaker.
A compelling proof supplies the evidentiary pressure that the later labels must neutralize.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign makes mere lack of presentation an inadequate account of rejection.
Turning away supplies the refusal enacted before the accusation is spoken.
A strong supporting side makes the refusal institutionally or socially braced.
The repeated deception label turns disclosed proof into alleged manipulation.
The repeated madness label turns the same proof into speech without reliable agency.

structural_cues: 51:38 places sending, compelling authority, and disclosure immediately before 51:39's supported turning and verbatim accusation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosed proof, supported turning, and the exact label pair; I infer that labeling protects the prior support by recoding evidence, while a live alternative is that the labels are only conventional abuse after rejection.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah reports a conventional insult repeated by former peoples.
changed_reading.after: The focus formula is a repeatable defense that converts manifest warrant into either manipulative power or mental defect, preserving an already supported refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same arrival and sending roots first carry a sterile wind that reaches things and leaves decay, then the focus names a messenger reaching former peoples. This reversible vector makes messenger-arrival read as a communicative interval set against another kind of arrival whose effects cannot be dismissed verbally.

activation_trace.role: The messenger's reaching anchors the focus side of the paired arrival pattern.
The message-bearing envoy makes the focus arrival communicative.
Dispatch and release extend sending from a human envoy to an inanimate force.
The sterile wind gives the earlier sending a nonproductive destructive character.
Reaching repeats the focus verb while changing the arriving agent and consequence.
Decay supplies the irreversible endpoint of the destructive arrival.

structural_cues: 51:41-42 sequences sending, sterile wind, reaching, and decay before 51:52 reuses reaching for the coming of a messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two send-and-arrive sequences with sharply different agents and endpoints; I infer that communicative arrival is an interval before destructive arrival, while the live alternative is lexical parallelism without a causal staging.

changed_reading.before: A messenger simply came to each earlier people and was insulted.
changed_reading.after: Messenger-coming is the answerable form of arrival placed against a destructive reaching: the labels reject the arrival that still addresses its recipients before effects replace speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: A true pair joins counterpart to counterpart, after which the speaker twice identifies himself as a warning that awakens caution and discloses meaning. Against that sequence, the focus ayah's or-pair looks like a counterfeit pairing: two noncomplementary labels are joined only to close every route by which clear warning could be heard.

activation_trace.role: Manipulative diversion supplies the first pole of the closed accusatory pair.
Covered reason supplies the opposed second pole, exhausting attributed agency.
Joining each counterpart to its mate supplies the local standard for a productive pair.
Warning that awakens caution identifies the function erased by the accusations.
Disclosure through speech makes the warning's intended epistemic effect explicit.
The repeated caution-awakening function resists closure by the binary labels.
Repeated disclosure confirms that clarity, rather than obscurity, is being recoded.

structural_cues: 51:49's created pairs are followed by the same clear-warning formula in 51:50 and 51:51, immediately before 51:52's ساحر أو مجنون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counterpart-pairing, doubled clear warning, and then the disjunctive accusation; I infer a contrast between productive pairing and a closure-producing false pair, while the live alternative is that the adjacency carries no pair-level comparison.

changed_reading.before: The two accusations are an ordinary rhetorical either-or.
changed_reading.after: The either-or is a counterfeit pair that replaces a clear warning with two jointly exhaustive reasons not to hear it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah tests whether separated communities transmitted the formula by linked counsel, then substitutes shared boundary-overrun. The same accusation is therefore independently regenerated by the same posture rather than inherited as wording.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predecessors create the historical separation across which recurrence needs explanation.
A saying circulating among people supplies the apparent transmission hypothesis.
Exchanged counsel between groups supplies the hypothesis that the next ayah raises and rejects.
Exceeding the boundary in disobedience supplies the shared generator of the repeated reply.
Overflow supplies a material analogy for recurrence produced by common excess rather than inherited wording.

structural_cues: 51:53 immediately follows the focus formula with a transmission question and a بل correction toward a shared description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the counsel question and its corrective turn to transgression; I infer that common posture, not contact, causally regenerates the same labels, while a live alternative is that 51:53 only denies literal coordination without explaining the psychology.

changed_reading.before: The repeated formula sounds like a slogan inherited or coordinated across generations.
changed_reading.after: Its sameness is the surprise: historically separated groups need no collusion because the same boundary-crossing posture independently recreates the same defense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away from the hardened group is followed by continued reminder because reminder benefits trusting hearers. This limits a totalizing reading of the focus ayah: the recurrent speakers form a resistant class, but the communicative field still contains recipients for whom the message works.

activation_trace.role: The voiced accusation identifies the speaking resistant collective without exhausting every possible hearer.
Turning away marks disengagement from one resistant audience.
Reminder as that which makes present sustains communication after disengagement.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies a positive effect for another class of hearer.
Heart-settling assent identifies the receptive audience for whom reminder remains effective.

structural_cues: 51:54 commands turning from them, but 51:55 immediately preserves reminder and names its beneficiaries.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disengagement followed by beneficial reminder; I infer audience differentiation that limits the scope of 51:52's pattern, while the live alternative is a temporal change of task rather than distinct simultaneous audiences.

changed_reading.before: The ayah's recurrence can sound as though every people and every hearer inevitably gives the same answer.
changed_reading.after: The formula characterizes a recurrent resistant speaker-position, not reception as such; reminder remains capable of benefiting other hearers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence gives wrongdoers a matched portion like that of their companions and withholds its acceleration. This extends the focus ayah's likeness beyond repeated words: corresponding communities become companions in a homologous, temporally delayed trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predecessors anchor the earlier side of the cross-generational correspondence.
An allotted share turns recurrence from verbal resemblance into corresponding consequence.
Likeness and counterpart relation explicitly bind the later share to the earlier one.
Accompaniment groups temporally separated rejecters by their shared trajectory.
Withheld acceleration makes the corresponding outcome delayed rather than absent.

structural_cues: 51:59 repeats the portion term around explicit likeness to companions, then tells the present group not to hasten.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched shares, likeness, companionship, and delayed timing; I infer that 51:52's likewise opens a trajectory from repeated diagnosis to repeated outcome, while a live alternative is that the final likeness concerns consequence only and does not look back to the accusation.

changed_reading.before: Likewise points only to the recurrence of the words magician or madman.
changed_reading.after: Likewise begins a broader correspondence: present and former rejecters repeat a verbal defense and become companions in a matched but not immediate trajectory.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping rather than ordinary قول morphology; it remains inspectably anchored in قالوا and the two predicates, but downstream prose should present it as a split-root activation, not as a translation of the verb.

activation_trace.role: Smallness and diminution make the utterance perform a social down-ranking of the claim.
The manipulator label supplies one dismissible type into which the claim is reduced.
The reason-covered label supplies the other dismissible type.

changed_reading.after: At the split-root edge, their saying also performs minimization: an intrusive claim is shrunk into two socially dismissible speaker-types.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets 51:56's jinn-human pairing activate a lexical branch inside مجنون rather than treating the later ayah as a direct gloss; it remains valid through the shared ج ن ن root and the focus form, but should be rendered as a local semantic reversal, not as the accusation's literal denotation.

activation_trace.role: Reason covered by madness supplies the focus accusation's removal of reliable human agency.
Hidden beings reopen the root field that the accusation had compressed into mental incapacity.
Visible humanity opposed to hidden beings restores the speaker's ordinary human side.
Shared obedient worship places both hidden and visible agents inside accountable purpose.

changed_reading.after: The label hides the messenger's visible human agency behind an unseen or covered cause, while the later jinn-human pair restores both hidden and visible beings to accountable purpose.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because ساحر normally activates deception whereas the food-dependent image belongs to the wider س ح ر derivational field; it remains packet-anchored and is sharply activated by the later provision and feeding language, but downstream prose should call it an echo of creaturely dependence, never a replacement gloss for ساحر.

activation_trace.role: Food-needing embodied creatureliness supplies the distant edge activated inside the accusation.
Nourishing provision makes creaturely dependence explicit.
Feeding another and seeking food sharpen the dependence relation.
Allotted giving reverses the direction from needy recipient to provider.
Extended solidity supplies the contrasting independence of the provider.

changed_reading.before: The magician accusation concerns deceptive technique alone.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the root field, the label also drags the messenger into food-dependent creatureliness, which the later provider-and-feeding reversal sharply relativizes.

strongest_changes: 51:38-39 turns generic recurrence into a worked mechanism: disclosed authority meets supported turning and is recoded by the exact binary.
51:53 shifts the repeated wording from inherited collusion to independent regeneration by a shared transgressive posture.
51:41-42 and 51:59 extend likeness from repeated speech toward paired arrival and matched consequence.
51:54-55 prevents the recurrence pattern from becoming a claim that every hearer is unreceptive.
summary.what_was_special: The context both enacts the accusation verbatim and asks why it recurs; its pairing, hidden-visible, and provision sequences also preserve several contained changed readings that a single rejection theme would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The contrast between created pairing and the accusatory or-pair may be deliberate activation or only close adjacency.
The messenger-arrival and destructive-arrival parallel is lexically strong, but their causal ordering is reader-supplied.
The food-dependence activation in س ح ر is deliberately branch-distant and should remain exploratory.
